definitions.gloss: forever; for all eternity; for ever and ever
definitions.explanation: Without end, for all time to come. A four-character compound (yojijukugo) from Buddhist vocabulary, used for emphasis, often with a negative or a strong promise.

examples.japanese: {未来永劫|みらいえいごう}⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{恩|おん}→恩：02550_on⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{未来永劫|みらいえいごう}⟦{忘|わす}れない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: I will never, ever forget this kindness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{未来永劫|みらいえいごう}⟦{変|か}わらない→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧。
examples.english: It's naive to think the current system will stay the same forever.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{未来|みらい}→未来：03748_mirai⟧ (the future) + ⟦{永劫|えいごう}→永劫：28301_eigou⟧ (an endless span of time, a Buddhist term).

USAGE:
Emphatic and somewhat formal. Used as an adverb on its own ({未来永劫|みらいえいごう}⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧) or with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. Common in promises and in denials: {未来永劫|みらいえいごう}⟦{許|ゆる}さない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧ (I will never forgive it).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{永遠|えいえん}→永遠：01873_eien⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: forever — the everyday word
- ⟦{永久|えいきゅう}→永久：01875_eikyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: permanently — often for things meant to last ({永久保存|えいきゅうほぞん})
